neighbours.label: The word that links a professional credential to its field or body ('certification in', 'certified by', 'certificate as'): the slot naming what the qualification covers, vs the same frames about non-credential things
fire: She completed her certification in first aid at the community centre.
Our electricians are certified by the national safety board.
He received a certificate in project management last spring.
All guides hold certification as wilderness first responders.
The clinic employs nurses certified in diabetes care.
To work here you need a licence to operate a forklift.
My brother is studying for certification as a public accountant.
Every instructor is accredited by the national diving association.
quiet: She completed her shopping in the market at the community centre.
Our electricians are admired by the local residents.
He received a letter from his manager last spring.
All guides hold maps of the wilderness trails.
The clinic employs nurses who live near the hospital.
To work here you need a car to reach the warehouse.
My brother is studying for exams in history and art.
Every instructor is loved by the local diving club.
